## Column rules

Each column's class, phase and note are its rule's; a rest rule takes every column of its
kinds no other rule matches, and must take exactly the number it expects. A mirror rule
takes each column's counterparts from another file kind's classification of it. A matched
or different column its ported tables write names that column first (`ratings:<column>`).

| rule | class | columns | rest rule expects | phase | note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key-game-id` | matched | 4 | - | - | The same nflverse game id. |
| `key-week` | matched | 8 | - | - |  |
| `key-team` | different | 22 | - | - | The same team codes except Washington, WAS there and WSH here, in the ported tables too (decisions/season_stats.md, kept on purpose). |
| `key-qb` | different | 11 | - | - | Both GSIS player ids, a scramble credited to its rusher. There a quarterback without one falls back to his snap-count id or his name, as in the ported tables; in the model's quarterback games a dropback with neither a passer nor a rusher id is no quarterback's. |
| `key-qb-name` | different | 6 | - | - | There the players file's display name, as in the ported tables; in the model's quarterback games the play-by-play passer name. |
| `gl-games` | matched | 1 | - | - | The games a row counts, written only by the ported tables. |
| `gl-home` | matched | 1 | - | - |  |
| `gl-score` | matched | 2 | - | - | The schedule's final score (here the game row's home_score and away_score). |
| `gl-result` | different | 4 | - | - | Here only as season-to-date features (the per-game margin is the model's target, computed from the game row's score). |
| `gl-same-pbp` | matched | 5 | - | - | The same play-by-play definition; equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md). |
| `gl-same-box-rates` | matched | 5 | - | - | The same play-by-play counts over the same attempts; equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, pairs pass_completions, pass_attempts, interceptions_from_rate, pass_touchdowns_from_rate and offensive_tds). |
| `gl-sack-rate` | different | 1 | - | - | The same sacks (PARITY.md, pair sacks_from_rate) over different dropbacks: there a two-point pass is a dropback (PARITY.md, cause two_point_tries, kept). |
| `gl-turnovers-on-downs` | matched | 1 | - | - | Fourth downs that failed, written only by the ported tables; the model's play-by-play aggregates no longer count failed downs. |
| `gl-snaps` | matched | 2 | - | - | The same scrimmage snaps, a scramble filed as a run play included (since 0.54.0); equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, pairs offensive_snaps and defensive_snaps). |
| `gl-dropbacks` | different | 3 | - | - | Scrambles filed as runs are dropbacks in both (since 0.54.0); there a two-point pass is one too, here not (PARITY.md, cause two_point_tries, kept). |
| `gl-scrimmage-epa` | different | 2 | - | - | There EPA over every scrimmage snap, the team rating's input (the ported ratings read it that way); here dropback plus designed-carry EPA, which leaves out two-point tries, kneel-downs, spikes without a rush attempt and runs a penalty wiped out, and takes in rush attempts nflverse files without the run flag (PARITY.md, pair scrimmage_epa_sum). |
| `gl-designed-runs` | matched | 2 | - | - | The same designed runs, rush attempts that are neither scrambles, kneel-downs nor two-point tries (since 0.54.0); equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, pairs designed_carries and rush_success_count). |
| `gl-carry-rates` | different | 3 | - | - | There over every carry (scrambles and kneel-downs too; explosive at 10 yards, stuffs without kneel-downs); here over designed runs, explosive at 12 yards (kept on purpose in phase 1, DECISIONS.md). |
| `gl-explosive-pass` | different | 1 | - | - | There completions of 20 or more yards per dropback; here dropbacks gaining 20 or more. |
| `gl-success` | different | 1 | - | - | There over every scrimmage snap; here over dropbacks and carries. |
| `gl-early-down` | different | 1 | - | - | There a snap without a down (a two-point try) is an early down and two-point passes are dropbacks (PARITY.md, causes null_downs and two_point_tries). |
| `gl-downs` | matched | 8 | - | - | The same flags read on every play, an attempt counted once (since 0.54.0); equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, the third-down, fourth-down and two-point pairs). |
| `gl-first-downs` | different | 1 | - | - | There first downs by penalty count too; here passing plus rushing first downs (PARITY.md, cause penalty_first_downs, kept). |
| `gl-fumbles` | different | 2 | - | - | There fumbles on scrimmage snaps, a lost one charged to the team that fumbled; here fumbles on plays that are not special-teams plays, a lost one charged to the team with the ball (PARITY.md, cause fumbles_on_scrimmage_snaps, kept). |
| `gl-penalties` | matched | 2 | - | - | The same counts, Jacksonville's 2001-2002 home games repaired here too (since 0.54.0); equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, pairs penalties and penalty_yards). |
| `gl-red-zone` | different | 2 | - | - | Both count the drives nflverse flags inside the 20 (drive_inside20, here since 0.55.0); here only those in which the team ran an offensive snap other than a two-point try, which leaves out kickoffs the kicking team recovered and the tries after return touchdowns (kept on purpose: DECISIONS.md, red-zone trips; decisions/integration_pbp_elo.md entries 2.8 and 2.9 attribute every remaining difference). |
| `gl-st-plays` | different | 1 | - | - | There the team's own special-teams plays (the special-teams rating's weight); here both teams'. |
| `gl-official-box` | different | 10 | - | - | There nflverse's official weekly team stat; here play-by-play first (team_stats_source "pbp"), nflverse where play-by-play has no value. Total yards there are passing plus rushing yards. |
| `gl-official-team-stats` | different | 4 | - | - | The same official stats, kept here only as totals (first downs; lost fumbles of every kind). |
| `gl-official-allowed` | different | 10 | - | - | The opponent's row of the same table, with the offense judgments above. |
| `gl-faced` | matched | 2 | - | - | The opponent's row; the same play-by-play definition. |
| `gl-carries-faced` | matched | 1 | - | - | The opponent's row: its carries, every rush attempt but a two-point try, equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, pair carries_faced). |
| `gl-defense-rates-same` | matched | 4 | - | - | The opponent's offense, with the offense judgments above (gl-designed-runs, gl-downs); equal in every team-game of 1999-2025 (PARITY.md, the pair of each column's own name). |
| `gl-defense-rates` | different | 7 | - | - | The opponent's offense, with the offense judgments above. |
| `gl-first-downs-allowed` | different | 1 | - | - | The opponent's row; there first downs by penalty count too. |
| `gl-nflverse-here` | different | 17 | - | - | There from play-by-play (the receiving columns copy the passing ones before the official override); here nflverse's weekly team stats. Fumble recoveries here include the team's own. |
| `gl-receiving-allowed` | different | 2 | - | - | The opponent's row; there play-by-play copies, here nflverse's weekly team stats. |
| `gl-player-stats-pbp-here` | different | 2 | - | - | There weekly player stats summed per team; here play-by-play sacks and interceptions. |
| `gl-player-stats` | different | 5 | - | - | There weekly player stats summed per team, blank in the seasons nflverse leaves unrecorded (tackles for loss 2003-2011, QB hits 2003-2005); here nflverse's weekly team stats, zeros kept. |
| `gl-epa-per-snap` | different | 4 | - | - | There nflverse's official passing and rushing EPA per snap; here play-by-play dropback and carry EPA per snap (the strength snapshot's ridge responses). |
| `gl-margins` | different | 1 | - | - | Here only as a season-to-date feature. |
| `gl-totals-here` | different | 10 | - | - | Kept here only as totals: two-point conversions, fumbles of every kind, and penalties of every unit. |

Third-down, fourth-down, red-zone and two-point rates here are on a 0-100 scale (proportions there). |

The strength snapshot's own ratings stay in the dataset beside them. |

None.
